feature: Five numeric MA attributes used by the original Gorynych final confrontation
evidenceType: Static supplied WoG3.58f PE inspection, with native VCMI controls separately identified; no Windows execution

observations.claim: Requires two arguments and source creature index0..196. Command switch table starts at0x752ab0.
Signed4-byte Apply at argument1, then change notification on writes.
First reset preserves the initial0x5944-byte creature table in0x7eb558; every reset copies the backup back to0x7acf00.
Saved-map loading and map-monster reset call that table reset routine.

originalUse.phase: Before the final confrontation teleport, outside active combat

nativeDesign.scope: Current game map, all matching owned and neutral stacks; shared creature library stays immutable.
nativeDesign.mechanism: Permanent BASE_NUMBER deltas on the game global-effects node, limited to exactly the remapped creature. Field-specific source IDs replace earlier values rather than stacking.
nativeDesign.savedState: Map-local original attribute values and existing serialized native bonuses; existing save version906.
nativeDesign.queryBase: Native installed creature attributes, including installed mod overrides; not guessed from a single JSON definition.

limitations: This does not port MA cost, upgrade or experience operations.
Nonpositive health, negative numeric values and writes during an active battle remain explicitly unadmitted; none occur in this original command.
The original final quest and victory are not established by the private attribute fixture.
